mapper.select: SELECT id, title, writer, created_at FROM board
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board(title, content, writer, pw) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{pw})
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title= #{title}, content= #{content}, writer= #{writer}, created_at= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id= #{id} AND pw= #{pw}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board WHERE id= #{id} AND pw= #{pw}
